articles.title: Delaware hit by rare November tornado
articles.description:
Meanwhile, severe thunderstorms bring hailstones the size of baseballs in Argentina
The National Weather Service in the US has confirmed that an EF1 tornado touched down south-east of Newark in the Salem Woods neighbourhood, Delaware, on Thursday. The tornado reached 160 metres wide, had a path length of 4.4 miles (7.1km) and reached estimated peak winds of up to 100mph (161km/h). There were no injuries or fatalities but windows and roofs were damaged on several homes, a large hotel sign fell on to a number of cars, and a semi truck overturned on I95. Although Delaware often experiences a few tornadoes every year, this is only the second time the state has had tornado activity in November since 1950, according to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration. The only other November tornado recorded was in 1989.
Severe storms have also resulted in tornadoes in Argentina as well as large hailstones. A round of severe thunderstorms moved through the central Córdoba province on Friday, bringing hailstones up to the size of a baseball (about 7.5cm in diameter). Parts of the province recorded up to 73mm of rainfall in just six hours early on Saturday. Such storms are common at this time of year. Water vapour from the Amazon meeting the Andes quickly condenses, resulting in massive cloud formations often associated with heavy downpours, lightning, tornadoes and large hailstones.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: Storm Charles causes floods and flight cancellations across southern Europe
articles.description:
Heavy rain and strong winds have also caused disruption across British Columbia, Canada, over the last week 
Storm Charles has brought destructive weather to the Iberian peninsula this week, particularly in Portugal and the far south of Spain. Heavy rain and strong south-westerly winds arrived first in the Portuguese island of Madeira, before the system headed towards the mainland on 11 November. A wind gust of 84.5mph (136 km/h) was recorded at Funchal airport, alongside rainfall totals reaching 355mm (13.97in) in 12 hours. In Lisbon, 183 flights were cancelled on Wednesday, about a third of its normal daily traffic, while Madrid Barajas airport had 155 cancellations.
After causing widespread flooding in Spain and Portugal, the system moved on a north-easterly track through southern France and then towards northern Italy. This resulted in significant flooding in parts of Cannes, some of which caused rock falls and led to the closure of roads along the French Riviera. The Italian weather service issued a red rainfall warning, its highest level, for the area extending from Tuscany to Venezia. Further heavy rain is expected to fall in Italy and the Balkans over the next few days, with the latest forecast models indicating an additional 100mm could accumulate widely, while totals close to 200mm are likely in more mountainous areas.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: Watch: King Charles III caught in torrential downpour at Antigua and Barbuda parade
articles.description: King Charles III and Queen Camilla were standing in an open-air stadium when the rain came on.
articles.titleJa: 映像：アンティグア・バーブーダのパレードで豪雨に見舞われるチャールズ3世国王
articles.summary: チャールズ3世国王とカミラ王妃がアンティグア・バーブーダのパレード中に突然の豪雨に見舞われた。

articles.title: How medical neglect killed Alfredo Díaz in a Venezuelan cell
articles.description: Despite government shifts, a UN report confirms Venezuela's repressive system remains active, documenting how medical neglect in state custody led to the death of regional leader and politician Alfredo Díaz.
articles.titleJa: 医療過失はいかにしてベネズエラの独房でアルフレド・ディアスを殺したか
articles.summary: 国連報告書はベネズエラの抑圧的なシステムが活発であることを確認し、医療過失が政治家アルフレド・ディアスの死を招いた経緯を詳述。

articles.title: Ecuadorian youth unite against neoliberal models and state violence
articles.description: Thousands of Ecuadorian students have taken to the streets to reject President Noboa’s temporary job plans, demanding permanent solutions for public healthcare, education funding, and rising insecurity.
articles.titleJa: エクアドルの若者、新自由主義モデルと国家暴力に反対して団結
articles.summary: エクアドルの学生がノボア大統領の一時的雇用計画に反対し、恒久的な医療、教育資金、治安改善を要求して街頭デモを行った。

articles.title: Beyond the beaches: The Dominican Republic and the global debate over deep-sea mining
articles.description: The DR wanted science to keep advancing and the International Seabed Authority to finish building the regulatory framework that the UN Convention had mandated it to develop.
articles.titleJa: ビーチを越えて：ドミニカ共和国と深海採掘に関する世界的議論
articles.summary: ドミニカ共和国は科学の進歩と国際海底機構による規制枠組みの完成を望んでいる。

articles.title: Venezuela welcomes opposition leader María Corina Machado home
articles.description: Venezuela’s Nobel laureate María Corina Machado returned to Caracas in a massive celebration after months in hiding and exile, sparking deep hope and sharp questions about the country’s political future.
articles.titleJa: ベネズエラ、野党指導者マリア・コリーナ・マチャドの帰国を歓迎
articles.summary: ベネズエラの野党指導者マリア・コリーナ・マチャドが亡命から帰国し、大規模な歓迎を受け、国の政治的未来に希望と疑問が浮上した。

articles.title: What comes after networked authoritarianism?
articles.description: October’s spotlight on Big Tech and Authoritarianism explored a range of relationships between tech companies and political actors across the global majority.
articles.titleJa: ネットワーク化された権威主義の次に何が来るのか？
articles.summary: 10月にBig Techと権威主義に焦点を当て、テクノロジー企業と政治アクターの関係を探った。

articles.title: The scandals and suspects surrounding Flávio Bolsonaro, according to the Brazilian press
articles.description: The former president's eldest son, Flávio, had been linked to embezzlement charges in his own cabinet. During the campaign, however, his resume was exposed even further
articles.titleJa: ブラジル報道機関が報じるフラビオ・ボルソナウロを巡るスキャンダルと容疑
articles.summary: 元大統領の長男フラビオが、自身の内閣での横領容疑に関与していたと報道された。

articles.title: The Brazilian left’s quest to ‘tame’ Meta: A narrative of denouncement and resistance
articles.description: In our October edition of Undertones, we examine a movement calling for accountability and coordinated online action to challenge Meta’s problematic content moderation policies and governance practices in Brazil.
articles.titleJa: ブラジル左翼のMeta「手なずけ」への探求：非難と抵抗の物語
articles.summary: ブラジルにおけるMetaのコンテンツモデレーションとガバナンス慣行に異議を唱える運動を調査。

articles.title: How the streets and a social media army led Lula to a historic win in Brazil
articles.description: After ending the first round 2.2 million votes behind his opponent, Flávio Bolsonaro, Lula won the election with a difference of 4 million votes, and will serve a fourth term as president
articles.titleJa: いかにして街頭とソーシャルメディア軍がルーラをブラジルの歴史的勝利に導いたか
articles.summary: ルーラは最初の選挙で220万票差で敗れた後、最終的に400万票差で勝利し、4期目の大統領に就任する。

articles.title: Warning Signals: Venezuela and the Risk of AI-Powered Chinese Digital Authoritarianism
articles.description: A report by the Australian think tank ASPI warns that Venezuela could integrate Chinese artificial intelligence into its surveillance system and expand its digital control capabilities.
articles.titleJa: 警告信号：ベネズエラとAIを搭載した中国のデジタル権威主義のリスク
articles.summary: 報告書は、ベネズエラが中国のAIを監視システムに統合し、デジタル管理能力を拡大する可能性を警告している。

articles.title: Queer mediums of the cult of María Lionza are redefining the gender binary in Venezuela’s sacred mountain
articles.description: An ethnographic look at Venezuela's María Lionza cult, examining how LGBTQ+ mediums challenge traditional gender roles and face discrimination while channeling diverse spiritual entities
articles.titleJa: マリア・リオンザのカルトにおけるクィアの霊媒たちがベネズエラの聖なる山でジェンダー二元性を再定義
articles.summary: ベネズエラのマリア・リオンザ信仰におけるLGBTQ+の霊媒が、伝統的なジェンダー役割に挑み、差別を受けながら多様な霊的存在をチャネリングする様を民族誌的に探る。

articles.title: Australian MP 'full of gratitude' upon leaving hospital after alleged car attack
articles.description: The MP lost both of her legs after the alleged attack outside her electorate office four weeks ago.
articles.titleJa: 豪議員、自動車襲撃事件後退院し「感謝の気持ちでいっぱい」
articles.summary: 自動車襲撃事件で両足を失ったオーストラリアの議員が退院し、感謝の気持ちを表明した。

articles.title: Prince and Princess of Wales arrive in India ahead of meeting with Modi
articles.description: Most of the engagements the royal couple will attend are related to the Earthshot Prize, which Prince William founded.
articles.titleJa: ウィリアム皇太子夫妻、モディ首相との会談に先立ちインドに到着
articles.summary: ウィリアム皇太子夫妻がインドに到着。アースショット賞関連の公務に臨む。

articles.title: Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says
articles.description: The Nvidia scandal has raised questions over whether advanced AI chips ended up in China, despite US restrictions.
articles.titleJa: Nvidia元幹部と関連が疑われる中国スパイ、2025年に退職とMegaspeedが発表
articles.summary: Nvidiaのスキャンダルは、米国の規制にもかかわらず、先進AIチップが中国に渡ったかという疑問を提起している。

articles.title: Clothing factories shut in Bangladesh as workers strike over pay
articles.description: Workers are striking over demands for a minimum wage of 30,000 taka (£182) a month.
articles.titleJa: バングラデシュで衣料品工場が閉鎖、労働者が賃上げストライキ
articles.summary: 最低賃金引き上げを要求するストライキにより、バングラデシュの衣料品工場が閉鎖されている。

articles.title: South Korea's top scorer in tax accountancy exam admits cheating
articles.description: Han Won-seok, 34, confessed to using a hidden camera and AI to get a near-perfect mark on the significant test.
articles.titleJa: 韓国税理士試験のトップ成績者、不正行為を認める
articles.summary: 韓国の税理士試験でトップ成績を収めた男性が、隠しカメラとAIを使って不正行為を行ったことを認めた。

articles.title: Philippines wins first Eurovision Song Contest Asia
articles.description: Front-runner Carmelle emerges victorious with her women's empowerment anthem Sobra-Sobra.
articles.titleJa: フィリピンがユーロビジョン・ソング・コンテスト・アジアで初優勝
articles.summary: フィリピンがユーロビジョン・ソング・コンテスト・アジアで初優勝。カルメルが「Sobra-Sobra」で勝利。

articles.title: North Korean hackers used fake video calls in $400m crypto hack, says FBI
articles.description: More than 900 victims are thought to have fallen prey to the FaceStealer scheme in the last 18 months.
articles.titleJa: 北朝鮮ハッカーが偽のビデオ通話で4億ドルの仮想通貨ハッキング、FBIが発表
articles.summary: 北朝鮮ハッカーが偽ビデオ通話「FaceStealer」で4億ドルの仮想通貨をハッキング。被害者900人以上。

articles.title: Australian teen missing in bush for six days rescued alive
articles.description: The 17-year-old's mum has joked that he is "grounded for life" and "never leaving the house again".
articles.titleJa: オーストラリアのティーンエイジャー、6日間ブッシュで不明後、生きて救出される
articles.summary: オーストラリアの17歳少年が6日間行方不明後、ブッシュで生きて救出された。母親は「一生外出禁止」と冗談を言った。

articles.title: At least 24 killed after bus collides with truck in north-east India
articles.description: Several of the deceased are college students, according to local official Atul Bora, but they have not yet been publicly identified.
articles.titleJa: インド北東部でバスとトラックが衝突、少なくとも24人死亡
articles.summary: インド北東部でバスとトラックが衝突し、少なくとも24人が死亡。犠牲者には大学生も含まれる。

articles.title: Indonesia's vice-president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
articles.description: The news comes at a turbulent time for President Prabowo, who faces a growing rift with his predecessor Joko Widodo.
articles.titleJa: インドネシア副大統領が辞任、与党連合の亀裂を示す兆候
articles.summary: インドネシアの副大統領が辞任。プラボウォ大統領とジョコ・ウィドド前大統領との間の亀裂が深まっている。

articles.title: Ireland contributes EUR 200,000 to strengthen trade opportunities in developing countries
articles.description: Ireland is contributing EUR 200,000 (approximately CHF 185,000) to the Standards and Trade Development Facility (STDF) in 2026 to strengthen sanitary and phytosanitary capacity in developing and least-developed countries. The contribution will support STDF activities that help countries meet international food safety and animal and plant health standards, as well as facilitate safe and inclusive trade.
articles.titleJa: アイルランド、途上国の貿易機会強化に20万ユーロを拠出
articles.summary: アイルランドは、途上国および後発開発途上国の衛生植物検疫能力強化のため、国際機関に20万ユーロを拠出。

articles.title: South Africa notifies launch of safeguard investigation into certain non-wired float glass products
articles.description: On 11 November 2026, South Africa notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards regarding the initiation on 3 November 2026 of a safeguard investigation into imports of certain non-wired float glass products.
articles.titleJa: 南アフリカ、特定の非ワイヤーフロートガラス製品に対するセーフガード調査の開始を通知
articles.summary: 南アフリカは、特定の非ワイヤーフロートガラス製品の輸入に関するセーフガード調査を開始したとWTOに通知。

articles.title: Ethiopia's accession maintains momentum as WTO members review progress
articles.description: At its eighth meeting on 9 and 10 November, the Working Party on Ethiopia's Accession to the WTO took stock of the latest progress in bilateral market access negotiations and reforms of Ethiopia's foreign trade regime. Leading a high-level delegation, Ethiopia's Minister of Trade and Regional Integration and Chief Trade Negotiator, Yasmin Wohabrebbi Saeed, reaffirmed the priority the government continues to attach to achieving WTO accession as soon as possible. Members welcomed the progress achieved while noting that further work is needed before the accession process can be concluded.
articles.titleJa: エチオピアのWTO加盟、進捗状況をメンバーが確認し勢いを維持
articles.summary: エチオピアのWTO加盟に関する作業部会で進捗が確認され、政府は早期加盟へのコミットメントを再確認。

articles.title: Germany contributes EUR 500,000 to strengthen developing economies' trade capacity
articles.description: Germany is contributing EUR 500,000 (approximately CHF 460,000) to the WTO's Global Trust Fund (GTF) to help developing economies and least developed countries (LDCs) enhance their participation in the multilateral trading system. Carmen Heidecke, Ambassador of Germany to the WTO, signed the Memorandum of Understanding on behalf of the German Federal Government at the WTO headquarters in Geneva on 9 November 2026.
articles.titleJa: ドイツ、途上国の貿易能力強化に50万ユーロを拠出
articles.summary: ドイツは、発展途上国および後発開発途上国の多角的貿易システムへの参加を支援するため、WTOのグローバル信託基金に50万ユーロを拠出。

articles.title: EU launches safeguard investigation on certain PET resin chemicals
articles.description: On 6 November 2026, the European Union notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated, on the same day (6 November 2026), a safeguard investigation on imports of certain polyethylene terephthalate resin chemicals.
articles.titleJa: EU、特定のPET樹脂化学品に対するセーフガード調査を開始
articles.summary: 欧州連合は、特定のポリエチレンテレフタレート樹脂化学品の輸入に関するセーフガード調査を開始したとWTOに通知。

articles.title: Director-General: Leverage trade and partnerships to build a resilient ocean economy
articles.description: The multilateral trading system provides important tools for the development of a healthy and prosperous ocean economy, Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala said in her keynote speech at an event on Trade, Biodiversity and the Ocean Economy: Pathways to Resilience at the WTO on 5 November. Highlighting the importance of strengthening support for coastal and island economies, she said: Trade is part of the answer. The oceans are an asset of the global commons that can best be managed through multilateral approaches. The event was co-organized by Belgium, Fiji and Portugal.
articles.titleJa: 事務局長：貿易とパートナーシップを活用し、強靭な海洋経済を構築する
articles.summary: WTO事務局長は、強靭な海洋経済構築のために貿易とパートナーシップの重要性を強調。海洋は多国間アプローチで管理されるべきグローバルコモンズ。

articles.title: Members review progress in resolving SPS trade concerns at WTO
articles.description: The WTO's Committee on Sanitary and Phytosanitary (SPS) Measures met on 4-6 November, receiving an update on the resolution of past SPS-related trade concerns raised by members, reviewing a list of new and previously raised trade concerns, and advancing work on transparency, mentoring and technical cooperation issues.
articles.titleJa: WTO、SPS貿易懸念解決の進捗状況をメンバーが確認
articles.summary: WTOの衛生植物検疫委員会が会合を開き、SPS関連の貿易懸念解決状況、透明性、技術協力について議論。

articles.title: Trade Policy Review: Viet Nam
articles.description: The third review of the trade policies and practices of Viet Nam takes place on 4 and 6 November 2026. The basis for the review is a report by the WTO Secretariat and a report by the Government of Viet Nam.
articles.titleJa: 貿易政策審査：ベトナム
articles.summary: ベトナムの貿易政策と慣行に関する第3回審査がWTO事務局およびベトナム政府の報告書に基づいて実施。

articles.title: EU launches safeguard investigation on certain new hybrid vehicles
articles.description: On 30 October 2026, the European Union notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated, on the same day (30 October 2026), a safeguard investigation on imports of certain new hybrid vehicles.
articles.titleJa: EU、特定の新型ハイブリッド車に対するセーフガード調査を開始
articles.summary: 欧州連合は、特定の新型ハイブリッド車の輸入に関するセーフガード調査を開始したとWTOに通知。

articles.title: Working Party chair visits Uzbekistan as WTO accession negotiations enter critical phase
articles.description: A WTO delegation led by Ambassador Sung-yo Choi of the Republic of Korea, chair of the Working Party on the Accession of Uzbekistan, visited Tashkent, Uzbekistan, from 1 to 3 November to support Uzbekistan's preparations for WTO accession as its negotiations enter a critical phase. The visit included high-level consultations with government officials on outstanding issues across the accession process and exchanges with international development partners and the academic community.
articles.titleJa: 作業部会議長、WTO加盟交渉が正念場を迎えるウズベキスタンを訪問
articles.summary: WTO作業部会議長がウズベキスタンを訪問し、加盟交渉の重要局面における準備を支援。高官と協議。
